About this item

  • GENTLE CLEANSING: Dove Original Beauty Bar Soap gently cleanses while helping skin stay soft and smooth. Made with ¼ moisturizing cream, this beauty bar delivers the care of a cleanser with the rich lather you love from a bar soap.
  • MOISTURIZING CARE: Unlike ordinary bar soap, this moisturizing beauty bar helps lock in moisture and won't leave skin feeling dry or tight. It leaves skin feeling softer, smoother and healthy-looking after every wash.
  • FOR FACE, BODY AND HANDS: Looking for a cleanser you can use every day? This gentle beauty bar is suitable for face, body and hands, making it an easy addition to your daily skincare and shower routine.
  • DERMATOLOGIST RECOMMENDED: Dove is the No. 1 dermatologist recommended bar brand. This pH-balanced formula is free from sulfate cleansers, parabens and phthalates and helps care for skin while cleansing.

Product Description

Product Description

Enjoy softer, smoother skin every time you cleanse with Dove Original Beauty Bar Soap. Made with ¼ moisturizing cream and a plant-based cleanser, this moisturizing beauty bar gently washes away dirt while helping skin retain its natural moisture. Unlike ordinary bar soap, Dove Beauty Bar won't leave skin feeling dry or tight. The rich, creamy lather rinses clean and leaves skin feeling soft, smooth and healthy-looking after just one shower. Whether you're looking for a body soap, facial cleanser or hand soap, this gentle beauty bar is suitable for everyday use on face, body and hands. As the No. 1 dermatologist recommended bar brand, Dove cares for skin with a pH-balanced formula that is free from sulfate cleansers, parabens and phthalates. It's gentle enough for daily use and helps support the skin's natural barrier. Pair Dove Original Beauty Bar Soap a Dove Body Lotion for even more moisturizing care. Dove is PETA Approved and does not test on animals globally.

From the Manufacturer

Milder than any soap, Dove Beauty Bars are one-quarter moisturizing lotion. This #1 dermatologist recommended cleanser replenishes skin's natural moisture that soap takes away, and leaves skin feeling soft and smooth.

Ingredients
Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Stearic Acid, Sodium Tallowate, Water, Sodium Isethionate, Coconut Acid, Sodium Stearate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Cocoate or Sodium Palm Kernelate, Fragrance, Sodium Chloride, Titanium Dioxide, Tetrasodium EDTA, Trisodium Etidronate, BHT, Sodium Dodecyl Benzene Sulfonate

Directions
Use daily or as desired on hands and body. Rinse.

Warnings
For external use only.

    The Dove Original Beauty Bar is one of those timeless skincare staples that truly lives up to its reputation. With its signature ¼ moisturizing cream, this bar leaves your skin feeling soft, smooth, and nourished — never tight or stripped. It’s gentle enough for daily use on both the face and body, making it a reliable choice for anyone who wants simple, effective cleansing.

    🧼 Why This Beauty Bar Stands Out

    ¼ moisturizing cream: Helps replenish skin while cleansing, giving that silky, hydrated feel.

    Soft, creamy lather: Feels luxurious and rinses clean without residue.

    Gentle on skin: Suitable for dry, sensitive, or combination skin types.

    Classic Dove scent: Light, clean, and comforting — a scent many people love.

    8‑count value pack: Great for stocking up for the whole household.

    🌿 Performance & Feel

    This bar is especially great for:

    Daily face and body cleansing

    Dry or easily irritated skin

    Winter skincare routines

    Anyone who prefers a moisturizing bar over gel cleansers

    It leaves skin noticeably softer after just a few uses, and the creamy formula helps maintain moisture even with frequent washing.

    🔍 Things to Keep in Mind

    It’s not designed for acne treatment, but it pairs well with targeted skincare routines.

    Because it’s moisturizing, those who prefer a squeaky‑clean feel may find it richer than typical soaps.

    ⭐ Final Thoughts

    The Dove Original Beauty Bar is a classic, gentle, and deeply moisturizing cleanser that consistently delivers soft, smooth skin. The creamy formula, clean scent, and skin‑friendly ingredients make it a household favorite for good reason. If you want a dependable everyday bar that keeps your skin feeling healthy and hydrated, this 8‑count pack is an excellent choice.

About this Item

  • GENTLE CLEANSING: Dove Original Beauty Bar Soap gently cleanses while helping skin stay soft and smooth. Made with ¼ moisturizing cream, this beauty bar delivers the care of a cleanser with the rich lather you love from a bar soap.
  • MOISTURIZING CARE: Unlike ordinary bar soap, this moisturizing beauty bar helps lock in moisture and won't leave skin feeling dry or tight. It leaves skin feeling softer, smoother and healthy-looking after every wash.
  • FOR FACE, BODY AND HANDS: Looking for a cleanser you can use every day? This gentle beauty bar is suitable for face, body and hands, making it an easy addition to your daily skincare and shower routine.

Product Description

Product Description
Enjoy softer, smoother skin every time you cleanse with Dove Original Beauty Bar Soap. Made with ¼ moisturizing cream and a plant-based cleanser, this moisturizing beauty bar gently washes away dirt while helping skin retain its natural moisture. Unlike ordinary bar soap, Dove Beauty Bar won't leave skin feeling dry or tight. The rich, creamy lather rinses clean and leaves skin feeling soft, smooth and healthy-looking after just one shower. Whether you're looking for a body soap, facial cleanser or hand soap, this gentle beauty bar is suitable for everyday use on face, body and hands. As the No. 1 dermatologist recommended bar brand, Dove cares for skin with a pH-balanced formula that is free from sulfate cleansers, parabens and phthalates. It's gentle enough for daily use and helps support the skin's natural barrier. Pair Dove Original Beauty Bar Soap a Dove Body Lotion for even more moisturizing care. Dove is PETA Approved and does not test on animals globally.
From the Manufacturer
Milder than any soap, Dove Beauty Bars are one-quarter moisturizing lotion. This #1 dermatologist recommended cleanser replenishes skin's natural moisture that soap takes away, and leaves skin feeling soft and smooth.

Ingredients Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate, Stearic Acid, Sodium Tallowate, Water, Sodium Isethionate, Coconut Acid, Sodium Stearate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Cocoate or Sodium Palm Kernelate, Fragrance, Sodium Chloride, Titanium Dioxide, Tetrasodium EDTA, Trisodium Etidronate, BHT, Sodium Dodecyl Benzene Sulfonate

Directions Use daily or as desired on hands and body. Rinse.

Warnings For external use only.
